evidence.detail: enter_date_dt is parsed with WOTC_TZ (America/Los_Angeles), so rotation fires at midnight Pacific per WIS JSON
WOTC_TZ = pytz.timezone('America/Los_Angeles') — the timezone used for all rotation date parsing
rotation_offset() adds only whole-day timedeltas (7 or 14 days), no hour adjustment — time-of-day stays at midnight Pacific
no commit found changing rotation time-of-day
